_comment: Enemy runners. speed in m/s, armor = fraction of damage blocked, evasion = dodge factor vs inaccurate throws, runs = runs scored on reaching home, cost = wave budget points, from_inning = earliest inning in Standard Siege.

enemies.name: Runner
enemies.text: A standard rival runner. Weak alone, dangerous in numbers.

enemies.name: Sprinter
enemies.text: Blazing fast and hard to hit. Bursts forward every few seconds.

enemies.name: Armored Runner
enemies.text: Steel plating blocks half of all damage and shrugs off slows. Jax's Cannon Arm cuts through.

enemies.name: Swarmer
enemies.text: Tiny pests that come in packs. Splash damage is your friend.

enemies.name: Jumper
enemies.text: Leaps over walls, traps and frozen turf. Immune to ground effects while airborne.

enemies.name: Trickster
enemies.text: Dodges sloppy throws, blinks forward and leaves decoys. Field Vision reveals it.

enemies.name: Captain Runner
enemies.text: Rallies nearby runners: +20% speed and 20% damage reduction. Scores 2 runs.

enemies.name: Siege Slugger
enemies.text: A walking wrecking ball. Smashes walls and stuns defenders it passes. Scores 2 runs.

enemies.name: Base Stealer
enemies.text: Sprints for the next base whenever no defender is aiming at it. Slow, root or stun it mid-steal to catch it stealing.

enemies.name: Decoy
enemies.text: An illusion. Worth nothing, but it draws throws.

enemies.name: Iron Slugger
enemies.text: BOSS. Nearly impervious iron plating. After each ground slam its armor cracks open for a few seconds.

enemies.name: Phantom Captain
enemies.text: BOSS. Phases out of reality and conjures decoys. Rallies runners like a captain.

enemies.name: Grand Slammer
enemies.text: FINAL BOSS. Home-run swings stun and scatter defenders. Calls in reinforcements as it weakens.
